register.labelZh: VOTE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: vote something down 表示投票否決某事;vote something through 則表示投票通過某事。；vote somebody in 可以表示某人獲投票選出;vote somebody out 則可以表示某人被投票罷免。；vote on something 可以表示大家正就某件事情進行正式投票。；這些表達常見於新聞報道、會議、選舉、學校活動和電視比賽。
register.summaryEn: Vote something down means rejecting it, while vote something through means approving it. Vote somebody in can show that a person is chosen for a position. Vote somebody out can show that the person loses the position. Vote on something describes the act of formally considering and voting about an issue. These expressions often appear in news reports, meetings, elections, school activities and television competitions.
